biotools.summary: The Aggregated Gut Viral Catalog (AVrC) is a comprehensive database of viral sequences from the human gut microbiome, created by harmonizing and expanding existing viral catalogs. It provides a unified resource for exploring the viral diversity of the human gut, facilitating research into the gut virome's role in human health and disease.
